records.description:
**The Opportunity:**
--------------------

**Position purpose**

 
 

Lead the global Supply Chain Center of Excellence across three pillars: Planning Excellence & Governance; Analytics, Optimization & Value Improvement; and Data, Systems & Digital Enablement.

 
 

Strengthen supply chain performance by establishing consistent planning practices, delivering actionable analysis and measurable improvements, and enabling reliable data and effective planning technology. Partner with regional supply chain leaders to build capabilities and sustain improvements while regional teams retain operational supply and inventory accountability.

 
 

**How you will thrive and create an impact**

 

**Planning Excellence & Governance**

* Establish global planning standards, business rules, decision rights, and exception thresholds.
* Define planning horizons, freeze rules, and handoffs between master supply planning, site scheduling, materials planning, and regional supply planning.
* Own S&OE/S&OP process design, calendars, review standards, and escalation methods.
* Establish Plan for Every Part (PFEP) standards and review methods for finished goods, raw materials, and packaging.
* Assess planning-process adoption and effectiveness, identify gaps, and lead improvements with regional owners.
* Build planner capabilities through training, coaching, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

**Analytics, Optimization & Value Improvement**

* Establish common KPIs, dashboards, and performance-analysis methods across regions.
* Lead capacity scenarios and inventory modeling to support supply, working-capital, and investment decisions.
* Develop inventory policies, safety-stock methods, and replenishment recommendations with regional teams.
* Partner with Manufacturing and regional planning teams to improve capacity utilization, campaign planning, and planning parameters.
* Identify and quantify value leakage, including excess inventory, expiry, write-offs, premium freight, and avoidable expediting.
* Develop prioritized improvement initiatives with clear business cases, accountable execution owners, and milestones.
* Track corrective actions and validate realized benefits with Finance, distinguishing recurring savings, cash release, and cost avoidance.

**Data, Systems & Digital Enablement**

* Establish master-data standards, business ownership, validation controls, and data-quality remediation processes.
* Prioritize SAP planning gaps and configuration issues and lead business resolution with IT.
* Lead the business workstream for planning system implementation and SAP integration, including requirements, data readiness, testing, and deployment readiness.
* Advance reporting and workflow automation to improve planning productivity and exception management.
* Develop AI-enabled reporting, exception insights, and commentary with appropriate validation and accountable business review.
* Lead planner training, system adoption, and post-implementation improvement.
* Maintain a technology roadmap aligned with planning needs and measurable business outcomes.

**Leadership and cross-functional alignment**

* Set a balanced CoE roadmap across the three pillars, prioritizing resources against business needs.
* Lead and develop the CoE team with clear responsibilities and performance expectations.
* Partner with regional supply chain leaders, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Quality, Finance, and IT to implement improvements.
* Communicate progress, risks, benefits, and decisions required to supply chain leadership.
 

 

**Measures of success**

 
 

**Planning excellence**

* Adoption and effectiveness of planning standards, PFEP reviews, and S&OE/S&OP processes.
* Improved planning discipline, handoffs, and planner capability.

**Analytics and improvement**

* Quality and use of analysis in business decisions.
* Inventory and capacity improvements delivered with regional teams.
* Reduction in value leakage and Finance-validated benefits.

**Data and digital enablement**

* Planning-data accuracy and closure of critical data issues.
* Delivery and adoption of SAP, Netstock, and automation improvements.
* Measurable improvements in planning productivity and decision support.
 

 

**What we're looking for**

 
 

**Required**

* Typically 10 or more years of progressive supply chain experience, including team leadership and cross-functional improvement.
* Strong knowledge of master planning, capacity planning, inventory management, PFEP, and S&OE/S&OP.
* Demonstrated experience establishing planning governance and delivering measurable operational improvements.
* Proven leadership of teams and large, complex transformation programs across multiple sites or regions.
* Strong track record leading planning-system implementations, organizational change, training, and sustained adoption.
* Deep SAP planning expertise, including master-data governance and configuration, sufficient to guide business design and challenge technical solutions.
* Strong analytical judgment, with experience directing BI reporting, dashboards, and optimization initiatives to improve business performance.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, establish planning governance, and deliver measurable operational and financial results.

 

**Preferred**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Chemicals or batch/process manufacturing experience.
* Experience leading a global-scale CoE or planning transformation.
* SAP and Netstock or comparable planning-platform experience.
* ASCM/APICS certification, Lean Six Sigma qualification, or an advanced degree.

 

**Disclaimer:**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

**Why Avantor?**

**Dare to go further in your career.** Join our global team of 14,000+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life-changing science.
 
 
**The work we do changes people's lives for the better.** It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor.
 
 
We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world. **Apply today!**

**Pay Transparency:**

The expected pre-tax pay for this position is

$139,500.00 - $235,175.00

Actual pay may differ depending on relevant factors such as prior experience and geographic location.

**EEO Statement:**

We are an Equal Employment/Affirmative Action employer and VEVRAA Federal Contractor. We do not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/province, or local law.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at recruiting@avantorsciences.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.

For more information about equal employment opportunity protections, please view the Know Your Rights poster.

**Privacy Policy:**

We will use the personal information that you have submitted to us in order to consider your application for the relevant role.

Your privacy is important to us. Please click here for our Privacy Policy which explains the purposes for which we will use your personal information and the ways in which we will handle and retain your information. It also explains the rights you have in relation to your information, and how to contact us with any queries or requests.

**3rd Party Non-Solicitation Policy:**

By submitting candidates without having been formally assigned on and contracted for a specific job requisition by Avantor, or by failing to comply with the Avantor recruitment process, you forfeit any fee on the submitted candidates, regardless of your usual terms and conditions. Avantor works with a preferred supplier list and will take the initiative to engage with recruitment agencies based on its needs and will not be accepting any form of solicitation.

Avantor offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, wellness programs, health savings and flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with company match, and an employee stock purchase program. Employees also receive 11 paid holidays, accrue 18 PTO days annually, are eligible for volunteer time off and 6 weeks of 100% paid parental leave (except in states that offer paid family leave). These benefits may not apply to employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement or those subject to other eligibility rules.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

The Plant Manager directs overall plant operations and the retail store ensuring the achievement of production objectives at the lowest cost consistent with the company quality standards and customer delivery requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.

1. Prioritize, schedule and delegate work assignments and directly supervise the plant staff to ensure the achievement of production objectives at the lowest cost consistent with company quality requirements.

2. Monitor suppliers to ensure that they efficiently and effectively provide needed goods or services within budgetary limits.

3. Direct or coordinate financial or budget activities to fund operations, maximize investments, or increase efficiency.

4. Evaluate, recommend, and implement improvements in methods and processes to increase productivity and quality.

5. Develop plans for the maximum utilization of materials, machines and employees.

6. Review production costs and product quality; modify production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of division.

7. Ensure proper maintenance of equipment and building and establish plant housekeeping standards.

8. Develop and recommend plant capital and operating budgets to ensure conformance to budgets.

9. Develop policies and procedures to ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental and various regulatory agencies.

10. Enforce safety and work rules and company housekeeping standards.

11. Recommend locations for new facilities or oversee the remodeling or renovating of current facilities.

12. Ensure compliance with all quality, SQF, HACCP, safety, and sanitation regulations.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Manage supervisors who supervise employees in the manufacturing of company products. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of this unit. Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

 **Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience

Requires a bachelor's degree in production and operations management from a four-year college or university plus a minimum of five years progressively responsible related experience; or ten years progressively responsible related experience; or a combination of education and experience. Requires the ability to operate a computer and

standard office machines. Requires a general knowledge of company products and procedures. Requires a working knowledge of accounting methods and cost control procedures.

Language Skills

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret blueprints, customer specifications, general business periodicals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports and business correspondence. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, customers, and other employees of the organization.

Mathematical Skills

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference. Ability to apply concepts such as algebraic formulas, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

Reasoning Ability

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Wear required safety equipment when on shop floor. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand. The employee is occasionally required to walk; sit; and use hands to finger, handle, or touch objects, tools, or controls. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.

 **Additional Information**

*The hiring range for this role is $135,000 - $145,000 yearly**. Actual wages will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, and candidate skill set and experience. Base pay is just one component of Jack Link’s Total Rewards package for Team Members. Other rewards may include annual incentive and program-specific awards. Jack Link’s provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.*

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**: 
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to be successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**: 
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The work environment is a plant / office setting with varying degrees of temperatures and noise levels. Exposure to manufacturing equipment movement and wet / slippery floors. Travel may be required.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER:** 
Jack Link’s provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic that is protected by federal, state or local law.

**E-VERIFY:** 
Jack Link’s is participant in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees. For information about the E-Verify program, please visit: http://www.uscis.gov/e-verify/employees

records.description:
**Why you will love working at Maola Local Dairies™**:

* Built on over a century of dedication, Maola is always looking ahead investing in our people, strengthening our communities, and securing fresh, local dairy for the future.
* Join a farmer-owned cooperative rooted in integrity, sustainability, and a passion for providing fresh, high-quality Maola dairy products.
* We prioritize your well-being with competitive pay, including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off, and more
* Our employees are an integral part of who we are — what you do and what you think matters.

**SUMMARY:**

The Plant Manager provides strategic and operational leadership for all manufacturing at Maola Local Dairies – Philadelphia. 
 
You will execute strategies to optimize safety, food quality, performance, equipment reliability, cost-effectiveness, and profitability. You will build a culture of operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement while developing a high-performing leadership team to drive sustainable results. This role requires a hands-on, results-oriented leader with extensive manufacturing experience, technical expertise in fluid milk processing and packaging, strong financial acumen, and proven success in a unionized facility. You must translate company goals into clear departmental priorities and ensure consistent execution across the entire plant.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**1. Operational Leadership & Manufacturing Performance**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for daily plant operations, ensuring production schedules, customer requirements, and business objectives are consistently achieved.
* Establish and maintain operational standards that drive improvements in production efficiency, OEE, throughput, yield, and order fulfillment.
* Demonstrate strong technical understanding of pasteurization, UHT processing, fluid milk manufacturing, and packaging operations.
* Drive equipment reliability and asset utilization through effective partnership with Maintenance and Engineering leadership.
* Establish disciplined management routines, performance reviews, and accountability systems to identify and eliminate operational losses.
* Ensure effective coordination between Production, Maintenance, Quality, Sanitation, Warehousing, and Scheduling.

**2. Financial & Business Management**

* Maintain full operational and financial accountability for plant performance, including operating budgets, labor costs, maintenance expenditures, material utilization, and manufacturing costs.
* Partner with department leaders to establish, manage, and maintain departmental budgets.
* Monitor plant financial performance against established budgets and proactively address unfavorable variances.
* Develop and execute cost-reduction strategies focused on eliminating waste, reducing overtime, improving labor productivity, and optimizing maintenance expenditures.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of plant P&L performance, cost per unit, conversion costs, and key manufacturing financial indicators.
* Ensure department heads understand their financial responsibilities and maintain ownership of their respective budgets.

**3. TPM & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the implementation and sustainment of TPM principles and continuous improvement methodologies throughout the facility.
* Establish a culture focused on identifying, understanding, and eliminating the root causes of operational losses.
* Drive improvements in equipment reliability, preventive maintenance execution, planned maintenance, and overall asset effectiveness.
* Challenge normalized deviance and reinforce adherence to established operating standards and best practices.
* Develop structured problem-solving capabilities throughout the leadership team and frontline organization.
* Establish meaningful performance indicators and management routines to measure progress, sustain improvements, and reinforce accountability.

**4. Safety, Food Safety & Quality**

* Establish and maintain an uncompromising commitment to employee safety, food safety, and product quality.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, company policies, food safety programs, and manufacturing standards.
* Partner with Quality and Sanitation leadership to prevent quality failures, reduce product holds, minimize waste, and protect customer confidence.
* Ensure incidents, deviations, and nonconformances receive appropriate investigation, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
* Promote proactive employee engagement and leadership participation in safety and quality initiatives.

**5. Leadership, Organizational Development & Labor Relations**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain a capable and accountable management team.
* Establish clear performance expectations and ensure department leaders demonstrate ownership of their respective areas.
* Build organizational capability through leadership development, employee engagement, succession planning, and effective performance management.
* Demonstrate authentic, approachable, and visible leadership throughout all levels of the facility.
* Foster a positive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented environment that encourages initiative, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrate the ability to effectively lead and develop a unionized workforce through constructive labor relations, consistent application of collective bargaining agreements, and proactive employee engagement.
* Establish productive working relationships with union representatives and employees while balancing organizational objectives, workforce needs, and contractual obligations.
* Address employee relations matters with professionalism, consistency, fairness, and sound judgment.
* Promote a culture of mutual respect, accountability, and shared responsibility for operational performance.

**6. Customer & Executive Engagement**

* Effectively communicate plant performance, business challenges, operational priorities, and improvement initiatives to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Represent the Philadelphia facility professionally in customer interactions, audits, and business reviews as needed.
* Ensure customer commitments, product quality expectations, and service requirements remain central to operational decision-making.
* Establish cross-functional partnerships that support broader organizational objectives and business growth.

**BASIC REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, preferably within the dairy, fluid milk, food, or beverage manufacturing industries required
* Minimum of 7 years of experience successfully leading a unionized manufacturing workforce, including labor relations, employee engagement, and collective bargaining agreement administration required.
* Minimum of 7 years of experience leading complex manufacturing operations with multiple production lines and supporting departments required.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience with technical knowledge of pasteurization, fluid milk processing, and packaging equipment and systems required.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience managing operating budgets, departmental expenditures, and plant P&L performance required.
* Minimum of 5 year of experience in improving manufacturing efficiency, equipment reliability, labor productivity, and cost performance required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience implementing TPM, Lean Manufacturing, or other continuous improvement methodologies required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience leading, developing, and holding department-level leadership teams accountable for measurable results required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience understanding of food safety, quality systems, regulatory compliance, and workplace safety required.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Communication
* + *Communicate clearly and effectively through multiple channels – oral, written, visual, and non-verbal – ensuring our messages are understood and delivered appropriately, whether in-person or digitally.*
* Accountability
* + *Take responsibility for actions and anticipate challenges before they arise.*
 + *Solve problems both within and outside of departments, proactively addressing issues as they occur.*
* Customer Focused
* + *Prioritize understanding and meeting both internal and external customer needs.*
 + *Ensure high levels of satisfaction and loyalty by anticipating customer requirements and striving for exceptional service.*
* Initiative
* + *Proactive in identifying opportunities and addressing potential threats.*
 + *Act independently and decisively, rather than waiting for situations to demand action.*
* Problem-Solving
* + *Possess the ability to identify and address complex issues with minimal guidance.*
 + *Skilled at analyzing challenges and finding practical, effective solutions.*
* Collaboration
* + *Take responsibility for deliverables while also supporting others to ensure that collective goals are met.*
 + *Able to work harmoniously with others toward a common goal, recognizing and valuing each person’s contributions, is fundamental to successful collaboration.*

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand and walk. The employee must be able to reach, bend, extend, and lift 50-60 pounds.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* The work environment may require working in the cooler room with varying degrees of temperature and may include contact with water or dairy liquids.
* Exposed to a noise level of 90 decibels. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate/high. Wet/slippery work conditions.

**Maola Local Dairies®** is a farmer-owned cooperative sustainably producing a full suite of nutritious dairy products. Maola processes milk, cream, butter, and dry milk powders through our network of six dairy processing plants. With a keen eye on quality, freshness, and love for the environment, Maola delivers dairy products that are both nutritious and sustainable to our local communities. For more information about Maola, please visit **www.maolamilk.com** (http://www.maolamilk.com/)**.**



**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status.**

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

records.description:
Cenveo is a leading North American manufacturer of envelopes with over 100 years of experience and approximately 30 billion envelopes manufactured annually. We are committed to safety, quality, and operational excellence.

We are hiring immediately for an experienced Plant Manager for its envelope manufacturing facility in Chicago, IL. The position will report into the Site-Leader/General Manager.

Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, Cenveo provides competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Job Summary**

The Plant Manager directs the manufacturing, maintenance, warehousing and distribution operations of a facility to achieve business goals including safety, quality, and production (including efficiency and profitability). They ensure compliance with all government regulations and corporate policies. Additionally, the Plant Manager serves as a liaison between the manufacturing facility and its clients, the Sales department, and other groups.

**Key Responsibilities** (\*Essential Functions)

*These are functions a qualified incumbent or applicant must be able to perform with or without reasonable accommodation.*

* Through direct action and the management of others, ensure the safe, productive, and profitable daily operations of an envelope manufacturing facility.
* Effectively use financial, & other, reports to monitor and improve facility performance on a variety of business related metrics. Prepare similar reports as required.
* Select, train, and develop subordinates necessary to conduct facility operations.
* Direct the plant supervision team in the enforcement and consistent application of policies, and plant rules which may include the terms of a collective bargaining agreement.
* Monitor, train and communicate safety and quality programs and ensure compliance with company policies and government regulations.
* Ensure the efficient and effective purchasing and utilization of all materials and services.
* Collaborate with sales to improve or modify existing products as needed, and to aid in new product development.
* Visit customer facilities, or host customer visits to the Cenveo facility to aid in sales, customer relations, or the resolution of problem situations.
* Monitor new trends and developments in business and manufacturing.
* Represent the company and facility in community relations functions.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Perform other duties as assigned based on business needs.

**Pay / Other**

* Salaried Pay Range: $120,000 – 140,000 annually
* Schedule: Monday – Friday; Saturdays required during peak production/business needs.

**Other (Non-Essential) Functions**

Includes functions which are normally performed by persons holding this title. However, these functions may be reassigned to other employees as part of a "Reasonable Accommodation" under the ADA.

* Other duties and assignments as required.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree preferred. Will consider experience in lieu of Bachelor's degree, emphasis on Manufacturing, Industrial Management, or similar preferred.
* Comprehensive experience in manufacturing, along with advanced knowledge in multiple related disciplines and processes is required.
* Experience in envelope, printing or packaging is highly preferred.
* Extensive experience Environmental, Health, & Safety.
* Six Sigma / Lean Manufacturing experience preferred.
* Managing teams or projects is preferred.
* Strong PC skills including Microsoft Office and internet research
* Strong interpersonal verbal and written communication
* Ability to work independently and with others, demonstrate analytical abilities, and be a strong and versatile leader.
* Must be a self-starter and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Ability to perform work, and resolve problems, that are complex and varied in nature.

**Physical Requirements & Environmental Conditions**

* Requires the ability to move throughout a manufacturing facility on a regular basis, including frequent walking of the production floor, climbing stairs, and navigating operational areas.
* Frequent exposure to manufacturing environment with one or more unpleasant or hazardous conditions including but not limited to dust, dirt, high noise levels, chemicals, etc.
* Ability to communicate effectively, hear, distinguish colors
* May occasionally reach, bend, grasp, carry, and lift and/or move objects weighing up to 50 pounds; manual dexterity as needed to perform job duties.
* Occasional travel may be required based on business needs.

**Employee Benefits**

* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Holidays
* Vacation / Paid Sick Leave
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Employee Referral Bonus Program
* Other Company Sponsored Benefits

**CENVEO IS AN EEO EMPLOYER**

Requirements:

* The minimum education requirement is some college coursework or Associate's degree. Bachelor's degree is highly preferred.
* Typically possesses 10 years of related work experience, with at least 5 years' experience in managing teams or projects. Requires advanced technical and business knowledge in multiple disciplines and processes.
* Extensive experience Environmental, Health, & Safety experience.
* Comprehensive experience in manufacturing is required. Experience in envelope, printing or packaging is highly preferred.
* Experience in Six Sigma or Lean Manufacturing is preferred, but not required.
* Strong PC skills including Microsoft Office, Internet and Hagen.
* Excellent written/verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organizational skills.
* Must be able to work well with individuals at all levels within the organization.
* Must be a self-starter and must be able to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment.
* Proven ability to perform work that is complex and varied in nature. Defines and discerns key aspects of problem and develops an integrated solution within a broad technical and business context of significant impact. May provide guidance/training to more junior staff.
* This position requires contact with employees, management, sales, account teams, call center, production staff, customer and vendors.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
***Position Summary***

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall day-to-day leadership and performance of the machine shop operation. This position provides hands-on leadership across machining, production, quality, maintenance, safety, scheduling, and employee development to ensure the facility consistently meets customer requirements for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.

The Plant Manager will drive operational excellence through Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, standardized work, effective production planning, and development of a high-performing manufacturing team. This individual will partner closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and other functional leaders to support business growth and achieve operational objectives.

***Essential Functions / Responsibilities*****:**

**Operations Leadership**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for daily machine shop operations.
* Manage production activities to achieve customer delivery, quality, productivity, and cost objectives.
* Establish and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly production goals.
* Ensure effective production scheduling, machine loading, labor utilization, and workflow.
* Identify and resolve production constraints, bottlenecks, and capacity issues.
* Ensure appropriate staffing and resource allocation to meet production requirements.
* Maintain strong floor presence and lead through visible, hands-on management.

**Machining & Manufacturing**

* Oversee CNC machining, manual machining, secondary operations, assembly, plating, Injection molding, deburring, inspection, and related manufacturing activities.
* Ensure equipment, tooling, fixtures, and processes are capable of meeting production requirements.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to improve machining processes, cycle times, setups, tooling, and machine loading.
* Drive setup reduction, machine utilization, labor efficiency, and throughput improvements.
* Ensure adherence to standardized work and documented manufacturing processes.
* Lead Hazardous Waste Coordinator for facility.

**Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the machine shop.
* Implement and sustain 5S, visual management, standard work, waste reduction, and problem-solving methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to reduce scrap, rework, setup time, downtime, and overall manufacturing costs.
* Utilize data and KPIs to identify root causes and drive corrective actions.
* Establish a culture of continuous improvement and employee involvement.

**Safety & Environmental**

* Maintain a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA and company safety requirements.
* Lead safety initiatives, audits, training, and corrective actions.
* Ensure proper machine guarding, PPE, lockout/tagout, housekeeping, and safe operating practices.
* Investigate incidents and near misses and implement appropriate corrective actions.
* Hold employees and leaders accountable for safe work practices.

**Quality**

* Partner with Quality to ensure products meet customer and internal quality requirements.
* Drive reduction of scrap, rework, defects, and customer complaints.
* Ensure operators follow documented work instructions and quality procedures.
* Participate in root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action activities.
* Promote a culture of first-time quality and process ownership.

**People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, leads, machinists, operators, and other production personnel.
* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, training, cross-training, and employee development.
* Develop a flexible, multi-skilled workforce capable of supporting changing production requirements.
* Conduct performance reviews and address performance issues in a timely manner.
* Foster teamwork, communication, accountability, and employee engagement.

**Maintenance & Equipment**

* Partner with Maintenance to maximize equipment availability and reliability.
* Monitor machine downtime and establish corrective action plans.
* Support preventive and predictive maintenance programs.
* Manage capital equipment planning, justification and implementation.
* Ensure new equipment and processes are effectively integrated into production.

**Financial & Business Performance**

* Manage operational performance against established budgets and financial targets.
* Monitor labor efficiency, overtime, scrap, rework, material usage, and machine utilization.
* Identify and execute cost-reduction opportunities.
* Support Supplier Development Activities
* Support Product Transfer activities which may include travel
* Drive capital expenditure planning and return-on-investment analysis.
* Understand the relationship between operational performance, cost, and EBITDA.

**Communication & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Conduct daily/weekly operational meetings and communicate priorities throughout the organization.
* Provide leadership with clear reporting on production performance, capacity, quality, safety, and staffing.
* Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Sales to resolve issues and support customer requirements.
* Escalate operational risks and develop action plans to address them.

***Physical Requirements*****:**

Required to sit, stand, bend, and lift up to 25 lbs.

***Work Environment*****:**

* Combination of Manufacturing and Office environment.
* Regular exposure to noise, dust, heat, cold and odors.

***Knowledge, Skills & Experiences*****:**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, preferably in a precision machining environment.
* 3+ years of manufacturing leadership experience with responsibility for people and operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of CNC machining and machine shop operations.
* Experience with high-mix/low- to medium-volume manufacturing preferred.
* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles.
* Demonstrated experience leading production teams and improving operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing safety practices and OSHA requirements.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems and production scheduling.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership abilities.

***Preferred Experience***

* Precision machining and tight-tolerance manufacturing
* CNC turning and milling
* Multi-axis machining
* High-mix manufacturing
* AS9100, ISO 9001, or other regulated manufacturing environments
* Hazardous Waste Management

* Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
* ERP/MRP systems
* Capital equipment implementation
* Continuous improvement / Kaizen
* P&L or operating-budget responsibility

records.title: Plant Manager (Yokosuka, Japan)
records.description:
**NORESCO, an OPTERRA Company**, helps customers modernize aging building systems and upgrade energy and water infrastructure to meet evolving demands. We implement innovative energy efficiency, distributed generation, energy storage, and renewable energy solutions that optimize the operational efficiency and improve resilience of buildings, campuses, military installations, and communities.

We are seeking an on-site Project Manager to oversee all preventive, corrective, and major maintenance activities (including repair and replacement work) at NORESCO’s 40 MW electric and thermal production facility at Yokosuka Naval Base, Japan. The cogeneration plant (CGS) is a critical asset for the base and daily operations are conducted by Navy personnel in partnership with NORESCO and our subcontractors.

NORESCO constructed the plant, which generates 50Hz and 60Hz power as well as a combination of Soft and Pure Steam, in 2008 under a Federal Energy Savings Performance Contract (ESPC). The plant pays for itself out of energy savings which NORESCO has guaranteed for the past 18 years. In order to meet our savings and availability guarantees, we employ a robust preventive maintenance program which relies heavily on Long Term Service Agreements (LTSAs) for all major pieces of equipment.

This is a Senior level position reporting to NORESCO’s Operations Manager and is administered through a 3 to 5 year International Assignment Agreement (IAA). This agreement is negotiated with each of our employees working Outside of the Continental Unites States (OCONUS). The agreement includes consideration for overseas pay, benefits, healthcare, housing, food, travel, vacation, stateside visits, relocation, etc., and is customized to the unique requirements of each new hire.

You will be the primary liaison between our NAVY customers, Japanese operators and subcontractors, as well as NORESCO team to ensure contractual obligations are met. While many of the team members in Japan speak English or are Bi-Lingual, some are not. Translators are available to facilitate conversations or process written correspondence as necessary. Japan is an amazing culture with many unique customs and protocols, a willingness to learn and adapt to their approach is an important part of your success.

It is of utmost importance for you to possess good listening, communication, and computer skills in addition to being proactive, organized, and having a bias for action. The Yokosuka Project Manager is supported by (and in-turn supports) many other NORESCO departments; Development, Engineering, Commissioning, O&M, M&V, Accounting, Legal, etc. Cross-functional technical skills, adaptability, versatility, and a quest for continuous learning and integration of advances are key in this position.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Overall contractual responsibility for plant maintenance and repair activities through careful management of Long-Term Service Agreements (LTSAs) and work orders.
* Ensuring subcontractor work is performed in a safe and professional manner with materials that meet or exceed applicable Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Regulatory standards.
* Participate in scheduled operations meetings and coordinate upcoming maintenance activities within the defined expectations and constraints of the customer and subcontractor availability.
* Prepare and distribute standard monthly reports (that summarize operations, maintenance, and repair activities) to NORESCO management, key customer contacts, and other stakeholders.
* Review plant operations logs, alarms, and performance data on a regular basis to evaluate equipment condition, collaborate with NORESCO team to identify potential issues.
* Perform plant inspections and safety walkthroughs during regular operations, confirm changes in equipment line-up, and subcontractor compliance with typical maintenance activities.
* Support Profit and Loss (P&L) management; assist with generating and maintaining the annual budget; capital expenditure planning; monthly forecasts, accruals, and variance analysis with development of recovery plans as needed to deliver the target revenue and profit.
* Review service agreements/proposals with manager; generate purchase orders as required; provide initial review and approval of invoices for materials and services.
* Collaborate with LTSA contractors to plan work and identify resources required for shutdown tasks such as parts, tooling, equipment, materials, and work procedures. Review and confirm subcontractors’ detailed work plans meet the customer and project needs.
* Maintain NORESCO’s Computer Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to generate reports for maintenance schedules, completion status reports, equipment histories, and forecasts.
* Coordinate with subcontractors, visitors and customers to ensure protocols are followed on matters related to site access, security clearance, safety measures, and work permits.
* Monitor warranty programs to ensure the planned and required coverage is maintained by complying with all warranty requirements. Ensure warranty work is claimed in a timely manner, and all warranty issues are resolved to minimize out of pocket expenses.
* Monitor and analyze facility performance and host data for equipment and systems condition assessments. Review finings with Operations Manger and adjust maintenance plans accordingly.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelors degree, Associates degree, or equivalent Technical Training (ex; Navy Nuclear)
* 5+ years of experience in one of the following fields; electric power generation, cogeneration, industrial utility, or district energy industry with strong working knowledge of equipment
* Ability to obtain a Federal Security Clearance for work at Government facilities.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**:

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management discipline or equivalent experience
* High level communication, leadership, technical, and project management skills.
* Strong sense of ownership and focus on maintaining; a Safe work environment, Uninterrupted Plant operations, Quality control, Project schedule, Resolving issues in a timely manner, and consistently meeting deadlines and commitments.
* Graduate degree in engineering or business administration
* Strong interest in engaging operators, customers, and partners to grow relationships.
* Advanced knowledge of one or more facets of Engineering or Central Plants operations; design principles, technologies, equipment maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Energy optimization, utility rates, energy costs, applicable codes, design guides, and standards.
* Robust combination of business acumen, risk management, and strategic thinking skills.
* US military or DOD project management experience, Japanese language skills, and international work experience are a plus.

**Physical requirements include:**

* Ability to climb stairs and fixed ladders.
* Ability to access rooftops and elevated work areas while following safety protocols.
* Ability to work at heights and in confined or industrial environments as required.
* Ability to maintain balance and mobility while navigating mechanical, utility, and production areas.

**Compensation:**

* $130,000 – $150,000 per year, depending on experience + bonuses

**Benefits:**

* HSA Medical insurance, with a choice of 2 buy-up options
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* 100% Safe Harbor 401(k) match
* 100% company paid Life insurance
* 100% company paid Long-term Disability insurance
* Short-term Disability insurance
* Flexible Spending Account
* Commuter Benefits
* Legal and Identity Protection
* Pet Insurance Coverage
* Fertility and Reproductive Health
* Generous Paid Time Off, including Holiday, Vacation, and Sick Pay

records.description:
Plant Manager

**Company:** Smitty Bee Honey - Defiance, IA

**Reports to:** President

Job Summary

SBH is seeking an experienced, results-driven Plant Manager to coordinate and direct all major plant functions. You will oversee manufacturing, maintenance, and warehouse operations while fostering positive employee relations and managing operational budgets. The ideal candidate will ensure strict compliance with SBH policies, food safety regulations, and legal requirements, while driving continuous improvement and on-time customer delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* **Operations & Production Management:** Oversee daily manufacturing, maintenance, and warehouse operations, ensuring production schedules and product quality consistently meet specifications.
* **Customer Fulfillment:** Coordinate and communicate scheduled open orders to guarantee on-time delivery to all SBH customers, supporting strategic efforts to retain existing business and generate new sales.
* **Continuous Improvement & Efficiency:** Identify and implement initiatives to reduce labor costs, material waste, and indirect expenses. Develop and manage labor utilization strategies that adapt effectively to shifting production demands and deadlines.
* **Equipment & Facility Optimization:** Partner with Engineering and Maintenance to minimize equipment downtime. Manage process flows, optimize plant layouts, and coordinate shutdowns and startups for new production lines and equipment installations.
* **Food Safety & Quality Culture:** Champion a strong food safety culture by ensuring strict site-wide adherence to Food Safety, Quality, HACCP, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
* **Workplace Safety:** Actively monitor, support, and enforce all plant safety objectives and regulatory standards.
* **Financial & Budgetary Oversight:** Consult with the SBH President on operational budgetary planning, forecasting, and disciplined spending.
* **Team Leadership & HR Partnership:** Collaborate with Human Resources on policy development, employee relations, talent development, and workforce motivation. Clearly communicate changes in company policies, procedures, and strategies to management and plant personnel.

Qualifications

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Business, Engineering, or Supply Chain Management preferred (equivalent relevant work experience will be considered).
* Experience:
* 5+ years of leadership experience within a manufacturing environment required.
* Prior food processing plant management experience in an HACCP- and GMP-regulated environment.
* Certifications & Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of HACCP, GMPs, and chain-of-custody management; current forklift certification (or willingness to obtain certification upon hire).
* Skills: Proven ability to communicate clearly, lead effectively, and influence team members across all levels of the organization.

Physical Requirements

* Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, talk, hear, bend, stoop, and kneel; occasionally required to climb, balance, crouch, and crawl.
* Frequently required to push, pull, lift, and carry up to 60 pounds with assistance.
* Routinely required to reach with hands and arms, involving repetitive motion of the wrists, hands, and fingers.
* Occasionally required to maintain balance while ascending or descending ladders or open stairs.
* Specific vision abilities required include close, distance, color, and peripheral vision, as well as depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

* Active, fast-paced manufacturing and production floor with heavy forklift traffic and moving machinery; constant situational awareness is essential.
* Exposure to varying climate conditions, including wet surfaces, temperature extremes (hot, unconditioned environments), and high noise levels.
* Strict adherence to food safety and PPE protocols is mandatory, including wearing hairnets/beard nets and following rigorous hand-washing procedures (safety training is provided).

Pay: $90,000.00 - $113,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person

records.description:
**About the role:**
-------------------

As Plant Manager for Eaton’s Critical Power Solutions operations in Santa Ana, California, you’ll lead two facilities, 500+ employees, and approximately $280M in annual sales, delivering engineered-to-order critical power solutions for some of the world’s fastest-growing customers.

This is a **high-visibility business and operations leadership role** with the opportunity to make a significant impact. You’ll co-own the P&L, lead the full plant organization, and help scale the operation as demand continues to grow.

**We’re looking for a leader who can:**

* Build and develop high-performing, cross-functional teams.
* Deliver consistently against safety, quality, delivery, inventory, cost, and financial commitments.
* Create a culture of structured problem solving using A3, 8D, PDCA, and root cause analysis.
* Lead through growth, complexity, and change while maintaining strong operational discipline.
* Make sound financial decisions around cost, budgets, capital, capacity, and profitability.
* Move comfortably between the manufacturing floor, customer conversations, and senior leadership discussions.

**What you will do:**
---------------------

**Lead people and culture** 

* Build a safety-first culture where every employee owns EHS, and keep our safety management systems strong through active, visible leadership.
* Be a visible leader on every shift: communicate openly, spend real time on the floor, and build an inclusive team where people want to stay and grow.
* Model Eaton's values and Code of Ethics in how results get delivered, every day.

**Run a high-performing operation** 

* Co-own the site P&L and scorecard (safety, quality, delivery, inventory, cost, productivity and engagement), set stretch goals and close gaps quickly.
* Turn the division strategy and annual profit plan into clear short- and long-term site plans and run a disciplined daily management rhythm to deliver them.
* Lead demand, capacity and inventory planning (our Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning process) so we keep our commitments to customers and to the business.

**Put customers first** 

* Protect on-time delivery and shorten engineered-to-order and configure-to-order lead times so we win new business and grow with our customers.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Project Management and Supply Chain to deliver end-to-end quality and customer satisfaction.

**Improve continuously** 

* Use the Eaton Business System and our continuous improvement tools to make lasting gains in safety, quality and productivity.
* Develop lean experts and problem-solvers on every shift, coach leaders to teach problem solving, and recognize teams that improve their own work.

**Grow the site** 

* Lead capacity expansion and footprint plans, including capital projects, new lines and cell layouts, automation and new product launches with Engineering.
* Represent Eaton in the Santa Ana community and build strong relationships with local stakeholders.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Basic qualifications** 

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, industrial operations, or similar fields.
* Minimum 7 years of experience with progressive levels of accountability and responsibility in Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, operational excellence (OPEX) and/or related support functions in a manufacturing environment.

 
**Preferred qualifications** 

* Master's in business administration (MBA) or other master's degree from an accredited institution.
* Lean and/or Six Sigma certification (Green Belt, Black Belt or Lean Tool Expert), with a track record of deploying a continuous improvement system.

• Strong understanding of Engineered to Order (ETO) and Configure to Order (CTO) business • Strong MRP / ERP platform knowledge, such as SAP or Oracle. 

* Bilingual (English and Spanish).

**Additional Information:**
---------------------------

* This role will be based at our manufacturing plant in Santa Ana, California.
* Relocation will be offered for this position.

records.title: Senior Director, Manufacturing Operations
records.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Saratoga Springs
* Req ID:R53229
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring a Sr. Director/ Executive Director of Manufacturing Operations for our new highly automated bulk/ drug substance manufacturing plant, supporting 20–30 tech transfers a year alongside commercial delivery responsibility. GMP production will run concurrently with construction and CQV for 3–5 years. This role requires both building and operating.

 
 

This site operates on a foundation of strategy, execution, and rigor. Every function at the site owns a pyramid of metrics derived from annual goal planning that connects the site’s strategic goals to the factory floor, with performance measured back up to leadership to monitor, track, and mitigate against contingencies quantified using SMART goals in days and dollars.

 
 

The Sr. Director/ Executive Director of Manufacturing Operations owns cross-suite production performance across upstream and downstream operations in both single-use and stainless-steel suites. As the site scales to six suites, this leader is accountable for delivery of the site production plan, manufacturing cost performance, and workforce strategy, drives daily operational discipline through MDI and lean standard work, and represents manufacturing on the site Leadership Team.

 
 

**When & where:**

* Location: Saratoga Springs, New York, United States

* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
 

 

**Discover your role:**

* Own cross-suite production performance and site-wide annual batch plan attainment across all operating suites

* Lead fully integrated, operations-focused suite teams, with upstream, downstream, and support activities managed within each suite, and clear day-to-day accountability for execution, staffing, and scheduling

* Oversee these functions OpEx and CapEx budget and roadmap

* Serve as the primary responsible party for this function's alignment with the Global Center of Excellence (COE), connecting site execution back to the business-level function

* Ensure this function's metrics flow up and down through the MDI structure, connecting into the site's S&OP, AOP, and long-range planning cycles

* Champion adoption of lean principles across manufacturing including standardized work, visual controls, and a culture of continuous improvement (kaizen) as the site scales to six suites

* Lead the production plan across all suites, working with supply chain to align the supply plan to the production schedule through the site S&OP process

* Drive the site's daily MFG MDI process at the suite level surfacing, escalating, and resolving issues in real time across all shifts

* Serve as the manufacturing process and cost owner, driving cost-per-batch performance and contributing to the site Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and budget

* Manage workforce strategy and ramp for the manufacturing organization, including multi-shift staffing, hiring, training, and qualification of operators as new suites come online

* Ensure cGMP compliance, right-first-time execution, and inspection readiness on the manufacturing floor, partnering closely with Quality on deviations and batch record performance

* Champion a zero-harm EHS culture and drive manufacturing safety performance across all shifts

* Lead manufacturing operational readiness for suites entering service, partnering with Technical Services on tech transfer, process readiness, and PPQ execution

* Build and maintain a lean, scalable manufacturing organization, including area management and round-the-clock shift coverage within each suite

* Partner with quality, technical services, supply chain, environmental health & safety, and operational excellence to resolve issues quickly and operate as one aligned site leadership team

* Establish high standards for performance management and accountability; develop and retain talent; perform other duties as required

* Own a gross margin improvement program and goal for this function, contributing to the site's overall margin performance
 

 

**This role requires****:**

* B.S in engineering, life sciences, or a related technical field
 + Sr. Director: 15+ years in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, including large-molecule drug substance operations including 7+ years of progressive leadership
 + Executive Director: 18+ years in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, including large-molecule drug substance operations including 7+ years of progressive leadership
 + Level will be determined based on experience
* Financially literate, with demonstrated experience of delivering production plan attainment, managing cost per batch, and operating within an annual budget

* Experience leading the start-up and ramp of manufacturing suites or facilities

* Experience leading large, multi-shift GMP organizations and building leadership depth

* Previous people leadership/supervisory experience

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.

 
 

Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.

 
 

As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.

 
 

For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.

 
 

**Salary Range (annually)**

$207,000.00 - $407,400.00

records.description:
POSITION TITLE: Plant Manager 
CLASSIFICATION: Exempt 
REPORTS TO: Plant Manager I 
SUPERVISES: Yes

POSITION PURPOSE: 
Responsible for overseeing and supervising the manufacturing and distribution departments by establishing, monitoring and enforcing policies and procedures to ensure that departments run smoothly and are aligned to quality standards. Creates and executes on strategies and policies for company growth. 
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND BASIC DUTIES: 

* Oversee and supervise the Manufacturing and Distribution departments.
* Provide for the timely manufacture and distribution of product against customer orders.
* Anticipates and tracks operational and tactical risks and providing strategic solutions.
* Plays a significant role in long-term planning, project status reporting, and implementing change control processes.
* Maintain average workdays to manufacture and ship all published catalog items.
* Maintain average workdays to manufacture and ship all custom manufactured items (RCC label)
* Provide monthly responses to budget variance.
* Provide for utilization planning by weekly reporting of the average Work-in-Process.
* Perform physical inventories of raw materials, packaging components, and finished goods.
* Provide for an appropriate balance of inventory to meet performance and financial objectives.
* Implement plant safety programs and ensure compliance with GMP.
* Confirm that appropriate work instructions are developed and maintained and followed throughout the business.
* Ensure that all ISO quality systems are followed.
* Provide compliance to ISO quality systems (i.e. Corrective Action)
* Oversee facilities and grounds maintenance.
* Oversees and reports weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual metrics.
* Identifies trends and assess opportunities to improve processes and execution.
* Completes reasonability testing and information validation prior to circulating findings and recommendations to key stakeholders.
* Solicits and responds to feedback while gaining commitment and support.
* Stays up to date on industry regulations, trends, and technology.
* Manage and supervise employees, resolve problems, and make recommendations for staffing and interviewing candidates for employment.
* Responsible for annual personnel reviews.
* Champions Functional Training Document (FTD) program through employee learning and development initiatives; standards of excellence & leader/employee accountability.
* Other Duties as assigned.
* Commitment to the organizations values; High Standards, Bias for Action, Teamwork, Customer

Obsession, Trust, Accountability, Innovation and Growth & Learning. 
Items covered in this job description are not all-inclusive of the expectations to perform this job 
satisfactorily. There may be times where management may require that you perform task not listed in this 
job description.

REQUIRED SKILLS: 

* Addressing operational concerns and issues, monitoring overall customer satisfaction.
* Developing and implementing operational procedures and policies.
* Analyzing training needs/requirements.
* Excellent interpersonal communication and organizing skills to coordinate project activities.
* Ability to communicate with others effectively.
* Ability to conduct research for special projects, respond timely inquiries, and present written/ oral briefings.
* Ability to work with details and time-sensitive issues.
* Good decision-making skills and response to high-pressure situations.
* Managing processes, developing standard.
* Tracking budget expenses, financial skills.
* Performance management.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: 

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry or Engineering-related discipline or a business-related area or equivalent work experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum of eight (8) years manufacturing management experience supervising manufacturing employees.
* Minimum of two (2) years of recent overall project management experience.
* Knowledge of HazMat, ISO, Distribution and safety programs.
* Experience with Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel skills with the ability to manipulate spreadsheets, create pivot tables and summarize data from multiple sources
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to work independently and with the team with strong follow through
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Accuracy and attention to detail
* A Project Management Professional (PMP) certified by the Project Management Institute (PMI) can be used in lieu of the educational requirements

WORK ENVIRONMENT: 
The physical environment may require the employee to work both inside and outside in heat/cold, wet/humid, and dry/arid conditions. This position may be working in the warehouse under various indoor environmental conditions, including supplemental heating in the winter months and without air-conditioning in the summer months. May be requested to work overtime and weekends. The position may occasionally be exposed to ruptured, leaking packages, some of which may contain Hazardous Materials. Where appropriate, proper safety equipment should be utilized and/or appropriate personnel notified. Frequently required to use personal protective equipment to prevent exposure to hazardous materials and chemicals. This job may require lifting of up to 50 pounds occasionally. 
INTENT AND FUNCTION OF JOB DESCRIPTIONS 
All descriptions have been reviewed to ensure that only essential functions and basic duties have been included. Peripheral tasks, only incidentally related to each position, have been excluded. 
Items covered in this job description are not all-inclusive of the expectations to perform this job 
satisfactorily. There may be times where management may require that you perform task not listed in this 
job description. 
Requirements, skills, and abilities included have been determined to be the minimal standards required to successfully perform the positions. In no instance, however, should the duties, responsibilities, and requirements delineated be interpreted as all-inclusive. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate. 
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, it is possible that requirements may be modified to reasonably accommodate disabled individuals. However, no accommodations will be made which may pose serious health or safety risks to the employee or others or which impose undue hardships on the organization. 
Job descriptions are not intended as and do not create employment contracts. The organization maintains its status as an at-will employer. Employees can be terminated for any reason not prohibited by law.

records.description:
### **Summary**

The Production Manager oversees the operations of the entire production facility (excluding purchasing, personnel, and non-production functions), with a focus on the Converting department. This role ensures adherence to company policies and procedures while driving optimal operational performance. The manager directly supervises Converting employees and supervisors.

**Perks of Pratt:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision Plans
* Short Term/Long Term Disability
* Supplemental Life Insurance Plans
* Child Bearing/Parental Leave
* 401K Plan with Company Match
* Paid Holidays/Paid Vacation
* Uniforms/Safety Shoes/Prescription Safety Glasses
* Healthy Lifestyles Program/ Virgin Pulse Fitness Tracker
* $500.0/Year Gym Membership Reimbursement100% Tuition Reimbursement/Assistance Program
* Income Protection Plans
* Legal & Travel Assistance Plans
* EAP/Home Auto Insurance Plans
* Wireless/Auto/Computer Discount Plans

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Production & Operations**

* Provide full production support, with a strong emphasis on converting machine performance.
* Maximize productivity and minimize downtime through effective resource management.
* Coordinate with Maintenance on PMs, MVP, and machine uptime goals.
* Oversee converting production, including equipment installation and major repairs.
* Support cost-reduction strategies and drive productivity improvements.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, safety protocols, and quality standards.

#### **Quality & Safety**

* Ensure plant focus on quality processes and tools for each converting machine.
* Maintain plant housekeeping standards and ensure machine cleaning programs are current.
* Drive safety initiatives and uphold OSHA, EPA, and company regulations.
* Oversee all audit protocols (third-party, customer, and internal).

#### **Leadership & Supervision**

* Directly supervise Converting employees and supervisors.
* Set and communicate quality, efficiency, and production standards.
* Provide training, coaching, conflict resolution, performance evaluations, and disciplinary action as needed.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, teamwork, and high morale.

#### **Administrative & Strategic Support**

* Evaluate new methods, machinery, and safety programs; contribute to planning, budgeting, and purchasing.
* Maintain optimal staffing levels daily.
* Communicate issues to the General Manager in a timely manner.
* Remain on-call and available after hours to address urgent production issues.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

### **Qualifications**

#### **Required**

* High school diploma or GED
* 10 years of experience in corrugated manufacturing
* 5 years of proven management experience in a production environment

#### **Preferred**

* College degree
* Experience with Ward Servo Pro Die Cutters, Bobst 8.2, and Gopfert Die-Cutters
* 5+ years in converting manufacturing operations
* 2+ years in a supervisory role
* Proficiency in Lean/5S, OSHA, EPA regulations
* Mechanically inclined with strong troubleshooting skills
* Strong project management and coaching abilities

### **Skills & Competencies**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Sound mathematical and analytical capabilities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead effective meetings
* Emotional resilience and conflict resolution skills
* Positive leadership presence and professional demeanor

### **Performance Measurements**

* **Operating Standards:** Meets/exceeds performance goals for production and customer service
* **Personal Growth:** Achieves annual professional development goals
* **Employee Relations:** Demonstrates effective team development, coaching, and motivation
* **Creativity:** Contributes innovative ideas to improve business operations

### **Physical & Work Environment Requirements**

* Regular walking, talking, hearing; frequent standing and reaching; occasional sitting
* Visual requirements include close, distance, color, peripheral vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
* Exposure to wet/humid conditions, mechanical parts, fumes/particles, and high noise levels

Requirements:

Pratt Industries is America's 5th largest paper and packaging company with more than 10,000 highly skilled employees dedicated to the environment and sustainability. Pratt Industries is one of the largest corrugated packaging companies in America, with sophisticated manufacturing facilities in more than a dozen states. The company operates three of the most modern, cost effective paper mills in the country, as well as a series of sheet and box plants strategically placed throughout the United States offering a wide range of creative packaging solutions. Pratt Industries is committed to recycling and the environment by “harvesting the urban forest." 
Pratt Industries offers competitive compensation plans with incentive opportunities, full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, FSA, All State, Pre-Paid Legal, and 401(k) with company match, paid vacation, and paid holidays.
