records.description:
General Summary
  
  
The Global Director of Quality is responsible for oversight of Quality Management and Continuous Improvement Programs for Team Industrial Services globally. The position is ultimately responsible for all corporate and Divisional Quality and Continuous support personnel. The successful candidate provides the necessary management and oversight to ensure the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of TEAM’s Quality Management System (QMS) as well as the supplemental Quality Control and Technical programs. Position is responsible for managing and coordinating all Quality support activities relating to the execution of the Quality Management System (QMS) for Team Corporate, Product and Service Line, Engineering and Manufacturing, and Operations. Global Director of Quality is responsible for operating on a cost-effective basis within the framework of company approved policies, objectives, and budgets.
  
  
**Essential Job Functions**

* Maintains a safe, secure and healthy environment by adhering to Company/Customer safety and quality standards and practices and to legal regulations, alerting others regarding potential hazards or concern
* Adheres to and is a champion of TEAM’s Core Values
* Establish a continuous improvement culture across the enterprise utilizing known methods and concepts such as Lean, Six Sigma, FMEA, Kaizen, Poka-yoke, CAPA, 8D, etc.
* Maintains contact with district, division and corporate levels to promote and instill a “Quality Culture” throughout the organization.
* Ensure TEAMs QMS is globally consistent and regionally precise based on local requirements.
* When necessary, provide training to affected personnel, including customers, to obtain maximum process efficiency, productivity, cooperation, and morale.
* Leads the Enterprise management review to evaluate quality objectives, assess the adequacy and effectiveness and continuing suitability of the existing QMS and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Manage the Supplier Quality Management program and supports third-party and Customer assessments.
* Ensures company-wide targets and objectives are established and action plans are developed and tracked to achieve them.
* Development and implementation of performance monitoring and measurement system of leading and lagging KPIs to evaluate performance across the entire supply chain – Supplier – Order Intake - Engineering – Manufacturing – Installation – Service – Warranty.
* Development and implementation of system of associating and tracking non-conformances with costs for supplier claims, internal issues and customer escapes. This includes understanding the company’s Cost of Poor Quality and Non-Conformance Costs.
* Stay up-to-date on industry trends, including Quality-related initiatives.
* Develops medium to long-term operating strategies and recommendations for plans and programs for increasing TEAM’s Quality performance.
* Prepare capital expense and operating budgets and ensure cost-effective departmental operations.
* Support sales efforts when necessary, including the completion of pre-qualification surveys and submission of controlled quality documents to customer representatives.
* Have a general understanding of all company products and services that are available to our customers, and how TEAM’s Quality program applies to these areas.
* Ensures the Enterprise external certifications (ISO-9001, Nuclear, Aerospace, etc.) are maintained.
* Other duties as assigned

**Job Qualifications**

* Requires a bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field. Master’s degree preferred. Continuous Improvement Methodology certifications such as Six Sigma is preferred.
* Experience in Oil and Gas, Lean Manufacturing, Petrochemical, or a Field Service Industry is a must.
* 15 years’ experience in Quality or Operational Excellence related function.
* Experience with problem solving methods such as A3, FMEA, etc. preferred.
* Experience in introducing/implementing a solid warranty tracking system that captures accurate Customer and or Field related issues.

records.description:
Apogee Architectural Metals
  
  
Apogee Enterprises, Inc. (NASDAQ: APOG), founded in 1949 and headquartered in Minneapolis, MN designs and delivers architectural products and services that enclose and enhance commercial buildings. www.apog.com
  
  
Apogee Architectural Metals is a segment of Apogee specializing in aluminum framing, windows, storefront, curtainwall, and entrance systems. We provide integrated capabilities, including design, engineering, extrusion, finishing, fabrication and assembly, across North America. Through our brands including Alumicor, EFCO, Linetec, Tubelite, and Wausau, we deliver quality, consistency, and value-added services throughout our portfolio.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Director, Quality is a senior quality leader accountable for transforming quality performance, capability, and culture across the business. Reporting to the VP, Operations, this leader will set the quality agenda, lead the Quality organization, and establish the operating discipline, systems, and leadership routines required to deliver consistent customer and operational outcomes. This role requires a proven quality leader who can move beyond compliance to build a scalable quality operating model, elevate accountability across sites, and influence leaders at all levels to adopt new standards, behaviors, and ways of working.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Set and execute the quality strategy, operating model, governance routines, and performance expectations needed to improve quality outcomes across sites
* Lead, coach, and develop Quality Managers and site quality teams to strengthen capability, accountability, decision-making, and execution discipline
* Build a scalable quality operating system that integrates QMS standards, metrics, technology, problem solving, and leadership routines into daily operations
* Use customer feedback, quality data, audit findings, and operational trends to identify systemic issues, prioritize action, and eliminate recurring failure modes
* Partner with the VP, Operations, site leaders, and functional leaders to align quality priorities with operational performance, customer commitments, and business objectives
* Lead significant customer, product, process, or operational quality issues with clear escalation, root-cause discipline, corrective action, and organizational learning
* Lead quality transformation initiatives that reduce variation, improve process capability, strengthen operating discipline, and deliver measurable customer and business impact
* Influence leaders across operations, engineering, supply chain, commercial, and functional teams to remove barriers and adopt new standards, behaviors, and ways of working
* Report quality performance, transformation progress, risks, recommendations, and business impact to the VP, Operations and senior leadership
* Develop and maintain enterprise-wide Quality Management Systems (QMS), ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory, industry, customer, and company standards.
* Lead supplier quality strategies, including qualification, performance management, audits, and corrective action processes to ensure consistent raw material and supplier performance.
* Ensure data integrity and leverage digital quality tools, analytics, and technology solutions to improve visibility, decision-making, and process control.
* Own customer quality performance, including complaint management, warranty reduction initiatives, customer audits, and key customer quality relationships.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Strong quality leadership with the ability to connect quality strategy, operational execution, customer outcomes, and business performance
* Ability to lead managers and teams while influencing cross-functional leaders in a matrixed, multi-site organization
* Strong communication and change leadership skills, including creating clarity, building commitment, managing resistance, and sustaining adoption
* Enterprise mindset with the ability to challenge current-state practices, address systemic issues, and raise the standard for quality performance
* Talent builder and operating leader who can align resources, develop people, and deliver measurable results through others

**Education And Experience**

* Education

+ Bachelor's degree in Quality Management, Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred

* Experience

+ 10+ years of progressive quality, operations, or manufacturing leadership experience, including accountability for quality strategy, performance, systems, governance, and standards
+ Experience leading quality managers and teams in a complex, multi-site manufacturing environment
+ Proven success transforming quality systems, operating discipline, metrics, governance, and leadership routines
+ Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, lead enterprise-level change, and drive adoption across functions, teams, and sites
+ Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) Development and Implementation Experience. Experience in TQMS (Total quality management system; this is more driven and aligned with our AMS and Lean CI activities). This also help to target few key organizations I like to target. Supplier Quality Management and Audit Programs Management. Policy Development and Deployment Experience preferred to form a strategy and deploy/implementation.

**Work Environment/Travel Requirements**

* Frequent exposure to manufacturing environment
* Overnight travel requirements will be variable based on projects and business activities, expected up to 50% depending on home location
* Physical Requirements

+ Ability to work in both office and manufacturing environments.
+ Lift up to 10 lbs.

*This job description outlines the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.*
**Our Benefits**
We care about and invest in our employees. We are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support their well-being and foster professional development. Here is a glimpse of what you can look forward to if you join our team.
  
  

* Competitive Benefits Package for employees and their dependents (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability)
* Incentive Plans
* 401(k) with employer contribution and match
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan with employer match
* Paid Time Off (Vacation and Sick Time)
* Paid Holidays
* Tuition Reimbursement Program
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Wellness Program
* Training and Career Progression

records.description:
Elevate is committed to providing the highest quality commercial roofing, wall and lining systems to solve our customers’ challenges, grounded by a 45-year legacy of proven experience. Our mission is to deliver solutions that save time, perform reliably and protect our communities. We are devoted to building partnerships rooted in trust in reflection of our Elevate promise that Nobody Covers You Better™.
  
  
Elevate is part of the Amrize family of brands. Visit ElevateCommercialBP.com to learn more.
  
  
We’re seeking a Director of Quality Assurance who’s ready to be part of a people-first company offering best-in-class products, exceptional training, and deep industry pride—all built to help our partners and team succeed.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Quality Assurance Director strategically leads the development, implementation, and maintenance of comprehensive quality evaluation and control systems across the organization. This includes overseeing the design and analysis of inspection and testing processes, ensuring the precision and accuracy of products and equipment, driving root cause analysis for incidents, and establishing compliance with reliability standards and documentation requirements to uphold the highest levels of product quality and operational excellence
  
  
**What You'll Accomplish**

* Strategic Oversight - Overseeing and directing the overall operations of quality assurance within a company to ensure continuous improvement and compliance. This involves defining and promoting a quality mindset across the entire company.
* Quality Management System - Developing and implementing quality management systems to ensure product and service quality, and maintaining and improving quality standards, policies, and procedures.
* Compliance & Regulatory Oversight - Ensuring compliance with industry standards, regulations, and company policies, and coordinating with regulatory bodies and external auditors.
* Quality Control, Claim Mgmt, Supplier Quality - Overseeing quality control processes to ensure products meet quality standards, and conducting regular quality audits and inspections to identify and address quality issues.This also includes establishing and enforcing quality standards, testing materials and products, and developing raw material and in-process product inspection standards.
* Continuous Improvement - Leading continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency, and implementing best practices to reduce defects and improve processes. This can involve applying tools such as CAPA, SPC charts, Root Cause Analysis, and FMEA, and leading Six Sigma or Lean initiatives.
* Leadership & Team Development - Leading and mentoring the quality assurance team, fostering a culture of high performance and professional development, and ensuring the team has the necessary skills and resources. Responsible for generating a culture of collaboration across the organization.
* Budget & Financial Management - Achieving financial objectives by preparing the quality assurance budget, scheduling expenditures, analyzing variances, and initiating corrective actions.
* Customer Experience - Gathering customer feedback through gemba and data collection on quality andperformance, ensuring products meet or exceed customer expectations, and implementing changes based on feedback
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas.
* Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Mgmt, or related discipline from an accredited university or college.
* At least 8 y+ years of relevant quality, continuous improvement, manufacturing experience including at least 5 years management or direct/indirect leadership experience.
* 3+ years of QMS / ISO9001 or similar experience required.
* CMQ/QE, CQE, CQA are all preferred.
* Six Sigma certification preferred.

**Additional Requirements**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators.
* Employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary
* Retirement Savings: Choose from 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth after-tax savings
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Medical, Dental, Disability and Life Insurance
* Holistic Health & Well-being programs
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health and dependent care
* Vision and other Voluntary benefits and discounts
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)
* Educational Assistance Program

records.description:
**Obsessed by Science. Entrepreneurial by Nature. United by Purpose.**
Diasorin is a global leader in immunodiagnostic and molecular diagnostic solutions, advancing science to improve patient outcomes worldwide. For more than 50 years, we have combined scientific rigor with an entrepreneurial mindset, operating with a strong commitment to innovation, accountability, and results to deliver trusted diagnostic solutions.
  
  
As the Diagnostics Specialist, Diasorin continuously invests in research, technology, and people. Guided by our values of operational excellence, customer focus, and teamwork, we empower teams to think boldly, act decisively, and transform ideas into meaningful impact across one of the industry’s broadest specialty diagnostic portfolios.
  
  
When you join Diasorin, you are not just filling a role. You are helping build what comes next.
  
  
**Why Join Diasorin**

* Build What Matters Take ownership, challenge the status quo, and contribute directly to solutions that improve patient care worldwide.
* Innovate with Agility at a Global Scale Work in an entrepreneurial environment that enables speed, collaboration, and global impact.
* Grow in a People-Centered Culture Thrive in a culture that values accountability, inclusion, and continuous development.

**Job Scope:**
The Director, Quality Assurance for Austin will lead, establish, implement and maintain quality assurance systems and activities ensuring compliance with domestic and international quality system standards and regulations for commercial medical devices designed, produced and marketed by Luminex. Partner with Manufacturing, Design/Development, Systems Engineering, Quality Control and others across functions to deliver the highest quality instruments, and reagents. This position is responsible for the oversight, control and release of instruments and reagents, quality organizational management, budget preparation, personnel management, organizational goals and metrics, and Executive Level presentations. The Director, Quality Assurance for Austin is a leader and a mentor.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Duties**

* Ensures that the Austin site demonstrates regulatory compliance per GLP/GCP/cGMP/GXP, ISO, and other applicable regulations.
* Support instrument new product development and manufacturing changes, provides guidance to the core teams and participate in the process.
* Leader in process optimization by Identifying and analyzing opportunities for continual improvements in product/service quality, customer satisfaction, and company profitability.
* Leads the strategy and improvements for the manufacturing and service depot of Instruments for our customers and partners in compliance with regulations and standards.
* Participates and manage activities for external audits such as ISO, FDA or other regulatory bodies for the Austin site. Acts in Audits - as co-host, SME or escort
* Responds to alleged QMS violations of regulations, policies, procedures as the result of both external and external audits by evaluating and recommending the initiation of investigative activities, immediate corrections and risk analysis processes. Coordinates responses to external audits and manages corrective actions to close.
* Interacts with various internal and external groups to facilitate the completion of internal audits, handling of non-conformances, performing Risk Assessments, CAPA, investigation and support, manufacturing validation as well as Design Transfer.
* QMS improvements and enhancements and is a leading member of the Quality Management Team. Works across the corporation to align and define quality approach for molecular diagnostic products.
* Partners with Site Leadership and Field Quality to conduct, manage, and evaluate investigations related to customer complaints, nonconformances, audits, corrective/preventive action concerns, deviations, recalls, and potential injuries
* Appropriately escalate Quality issues to the Vice President Quality Assurance Molecular Division
* Provide leadership in the application of Quality Tools such as Risk Management, Root Cause Investigations, Designs of Experiments, Capability Studies, in the establishment and investigation of process and products failures and implement lasting solutions of such failures.
* May act as IVDR Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) for Luminex sites to ensure: the conformity of the devices is appropriately checked before a device is released, the post-market surveillance and reporting obligations are fulfilled and all requirements established between Luminex and Authorized representative are met.
* May act as Management Representative for the site. In this capacity, ensure that product meets label claims and customer satisfaction, any quality or regulatory issue is elevated to the President and/or Vice President Quality Assurance Compliance North America and oversee and drive continuous improvement.
* Develops and releases Change Plans and actions to support the changing needs and requirements of the organization as the result of strategic changes in business direction
* Provide other Quality related technical training as necessary
* Directs activities of employees or through managers who exercise full supervision for daily operations. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
* Maintains talent through recruiting and development opportunities. Continually develops internal candidates through succession planning and career development.
* Responsible for enforcing all EHS policies in their span of control
* Be part of any the new key and strategic projects and due diligence process if required
* Ensure all site-level activities and related documentation are aligned with corporate procedures and conducted in accordance with DiaSorin’s established Corporate and Quality Assurance governance requirements.

**Education, Experience And Qualifications**

* Minimum Bachelor degree in a science or engineering discipline with 8+ years of relevant experience/training
* 10+ Years of Experience in Quality Assurance or Regulatory Affairs activities in a cGMP Medical Device or Pharmaceutical environment
* 5+ years of Demonstrated knowledge of current industry quality practices under ISO 13485, ISO 14971, CFR 820 and CFR 806 and international regulations preferred
* 2+ years of Management experience in a complex quality assurance/quality systems field
* 2+ years of Ability to provide leadership to others in the organization through influence, innovative practices and coaching skills to foster a corporate culture of responsiveness, compliance awareness, self-regulation, quality system ownership, challenge of status quo, and continuous improvement in order to achieve the highest level of compliance.

We're looking for talented individuals who share our passion for excellence and innovation.
  
  
**Position Overview**
This role provides senior leadership and ownership of the functions that safeguard product integrity and the operating environment: Quality, Compliance (Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Safety and regulatory conformance), Security, and Facilities. The position is accountable for ensuring that products consistently meet quality specifications, that operations remain fully compliant with regulatory and safety standards, that the site and its products are secure, and that facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment. The role establishes clear metrics and ownership across these areas and reports performance to senior leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Quality: Establish and maintain quality control protocols for raw materials, components, and finished products. Design inspection and testing processes and provide guidance on maintaining consistent quality from the beginning of production through final release. Lead Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, monitor quality metrics, and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to eliminate root causes of defects. Ensure conformance to customer, product, and industry specifications.
* Compliance: Ensure full compliance of operations with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and applicable safety standards in accordance with New Jersey law. Own audits, certifications, and documentation, and serve as the primary liaison with regulatory bodies, auditors, and customers on compliance matters. Identify potential risks and pitfalls (e.g., equipment failures or other disruptions) and develop strategies to mitigate these issues through process improvement, alternative suppliers of materials, or altered equipment.
* Security: Oversee physical and product security programs consistent with the company's trust and authentication mission. Establish and enforce protocols to protect raw materials, work-in-process, finished goods, and sensitive assets throughout the facility and supply chain. Ensure operations meet payment-industry and customer security requirements, and manage security personnel and access controls across all shifts.
* Accountability: Own the key performance indicators and reporting for quality, compliance, security, and facilities. Establish clear ownership, metrics, and dashboards, report performance to senior management, and foster a culture of accountability across the organization. Manage a team of approximately 35 people across 7 shifts supporting QA, Safety & Security.
* Facilities: Oversee facility operations, maintenance, and environmental health and safety of the buildings, grounds, and utilities. Ensure facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment, manage facility vendors and contractors, and lead facility-related capital projects, space planning, and safe-workplace initiatives.

records.description:
Global Director, Operational Excellence COE
  
  
At Nouryon, our global team takes positive action every day, to reach higher collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society’s needs – today and in the future.
  
  
We are looking for team members who bring ideas forward, champion others and work together to do better. Does that sound like you?
  
  
**About the job**
The Global Director, Operational Excellence (OpEx) COE is a senior leadership role responsible for defining the strategic direction, standards, and governance of Nouryon’s global OpEx program. This role owns the organizational design, frameworks, methodologies, and capability pipelines that enable sustainable continuous improvement across 63 manufacturing sites in the Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) organization – spanning the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific.
  
  
This role is the architect of OpEx productivity engine. The COE Director owns the design of the systems, standards, and organizational capabilities that enable VMC and FMC delivery – including ownership of the enterprise systems of record for productivity tracking (ANT) and performance reporting (PowerBI). Execution of productivity targets is driven through the regional OpEx Manager network; this role ensures those teams are equipped, aligned, and operating within a governance structure capable of sustaining results.
  
  
This role leads a newly consolidated Center of Excellence that brings together CI methodology and Lean/Six Sigma certification, ISC Learning & Development, End-to-End Process Management, and Manufacturing Excellence under a single governance structure. The COE Director sets priorities, establishes the program architecture, and holds accountability for outcomes – operating through a team of direct reports who own execution across regions. Key relationships span the COO, regional OpEx Managers, Site Directors, and ISC functional leaders across three regions.
  
  
This is a permanent, full-time position reporting to the VP, Global Operational Excellence & Digital Manufacturing, based in a Nouryon regional hub (Amsterdam, Houston, or Shanghai) with global travel of 15–25%.
  
  
**In your future role as the Global Director, Operational Excellence COE, you will**
**CI Methodology, Standards & Governance**

* Own the global Operational Excellence methodology, ensuring a consistent, fit-for-purpose CI framework is deployed across all 63 Nouryon manufacturing sites.

* Define and govern the Lean/Six Sigma certification pathway from Yellow Belt through Master Black Belt, establishing quality standards for program content, assessment, and progression.
* Partner with regional OpEx Managers to translate global standards into site-level execution plans, maintaining strategic alignment while enabling regional adaptation.
* Establish and sustain a durable CI Governance model – defining the review cadence, accountability structure, and performance mechanisms that ensure CI maturity compounds over time across the Nouryon network.
* Own the enterprise systems of record for productivity tracking and performance reporting, including the ANT productivity platform and PowerBI reporting architecture, ensuring data integrity and leadership visibility across all sites.

**ISC Learning & Development**

* Lead the design and continuous improvement of the ISC Learning & Development program, spanning CI capability, technical skills, and leadership development for the ISC organization.
* Direct the L&D team to build and maintain a structured curriculum that supports onboarding, role progression, and organizational capability uplift.
* Connect L&D investment directly to VMC and FMC delivery targets, ensuring program outcomes are measurable and business-relevant.
* Own the design mandate for Digital Literacy and AI capability across the ISC organization – defining the people, process, and metrics framework required to build and sustain enterprise AI competency at scale. This includes establishing program objectives, identifying ownership, and proposing a deployment model aligned to Nouryon’s broader digital strategy.

**End-to-End Process Management**

* Own the ISC End-to-End process architecture, defining process standards, documentation requirements, and governance for core ISC value streams.
* Drive process modeling and SIPOC-level design across ISC, working through the Process Modeler and Global Process Owner to ensure clarity of accountability and performance standards.
* Identify and close process design gaps that create risk, inefficiency, or measurement inconsistency across the ISC organization.

**Manufacturing Excellence**

* Define the Manufacturing Excellence framework for Nouryon, including OEE, TPM, reliability, and asset performance standards applied across the manufacturing network.
* Direct the Manufacturing Excellence Manager to develop and deploy site-level improvement programs, closing the loop between plant performance data and structured intervention.
* Integrate manufacturing excellence priorities into the broader OpEx roadmap, ensuring alignment with Digital Manufacturing, Palantir-enabled analytics, and capital investment decisions.

**People Leadership & COE Development**

* Lead a geographically distributed team of nine direct reports
* Define team structure, role clarity, and succession priorities for the COE
* Build a high-performance COE culture grounded in Nouryon’s Leadership Capability Framework

This role requires approximately 15–25% global travel across the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific.
  
  
**Key Performance Indicators**
The Global Director, Operational Excellence COE is measured against the same Breakthrough KPIs as the VP, Global Operational Excellence & Digital Manufacturing. This alignment is intentional – the COE’s organizational design, capability systems, and governance structures exist to enable these outcomes. Execution is driven through the regional OpEx Manager network; this role is accountable for building and sustaining the organization capable of delivering them.
  

* People Safety
* Process Safety
* FMC — Fixed Manufacturing Cost Productivity
* VMC — Variable Manufacturing Cost Productivity
* OEE — Overall Equipment Effectiveness
* OTIF — On-Time In-Full
* Quality Sigma Level
* CI Activation Rate

**We believe you bring**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* A minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in Operational Excellence, Continuous Improvement, or manufacturing leadership roles in a global, multi-site environment.
* Certified Master Black Belt (MBB) or Black Belt in Lean/Six Sigma, with demonstrated capability to design, govern, and quality-assure a full belt certification program.
* Proven track record of leading change management initiatives in large, matrixed, multi-regional organizations – with the ability to align diverse stakeholders and shift organizational culture.

* Demonstrated people leadership across multiple geographies and organizational grades, including experience developing high-performing teams in a distributed structure.

You are energized by building – building teams, building programs, building the conditions for others to succeed. You know how to hold standards without being rigid, and how to drive urgency without creating chaos. The right candidate is someone who finds genuine satisfaction in watching a global organization improve because of the systems they put in place – and who brings the patience, persistence, and precision that transformation at scale demands.
  
  
**We offer you**
This is a rare opportunity to architect and lead a newly consolidated global COE with a clear mandate from senior leadership, a defined team, and direct line of sight to enterprise value delivery. You will operate with significant autonomy, build the structure you believe is right, and leave a measurable legacy across a global manufacturing organization at an inflection point in its CI and digital transformation journey.
  
  
At Nouryon, we provide a great job and friendly coworkers, plus benefits in addition to salary.

Please apply via our online recruitment system. We will not accept applications via e-mail. Once it's with us we will review to see if we have a match between your skills and the role! For more information about our hiring process, visit: nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/

**Position Summary**
Assist with development of Corporate Improvement strategies and carry out transformation and strategy deployment within business area. Based on Corporate Continuous Improvement strategies, develop lean strategy applicable to the business to enable execution. Influence and coach senior management and their teams on Business transformation, cultural change, engagement, Lean tool adoption, and empowerment, with a passionate approach to results. Drive results through the use of common metrics and data in various areas of the organization including those with environments of ambiguity. Provide coaching, training, and lead management workshops on principles of continuous improvement, cultural transformation, and leadership mindset. Demonstrated ability to coach VP and SVP levels of Executive Management on Transformation.
  
  
**50-75% domestic and international travel**
**What You’ll Do As a Director Continuous Improvement**

* Organize senior management CI/lean steering committee and activities to set direction for business transformation and provide guidance to execute. Ensures that all local steering committees are supported and operate effectively.
* Collaborate with business leaders to facilitate and lead cultural and strategic changes across functional departmental boundaries within designated business area.
* Advise and counsel leadership by providing strategic direction in prioritizing CI opportunities and ensuring that CI initiatives align with the business strategy.
* Develop and implement a team-based learning environment along with the appropriate structure to sustain improvements.
* Create and implement transformation plans across the organization based on Corporate Continuous Improvement strategy, and local business strategy, and directly manage CI initiatives and programs.
* Drive Continuous Improvement implementation to achieve cost reductions, cycle time improvements, and quality improvements through effective Lean tool management, benchmarking, Key Performance Indicator development, and scorecard development and monitoring for various functions within the organization.
* Develops and leads team to apply structured, technical problem solving methodologies such as DMAIC, six sigma green belt/black belt, statistical data analysis, etc. to confirm root causes of problems, in alignment with strategic needs.
* Assesses, coaches, and provides constructive feedback to teams to strengthen competencies within the enterprise.
* Implement methods to identify Continuous Improvement opportunities within the organization through the use of key metrics, analysis, accountability, and standardization.
* Provides advice and consultation as a transformation subject matter expert on best practices, significant projects, and/or special Continuous Improvement initiatives.
* Drives team to implement corrective and preventative actions to solve root causes and prevent recurrence, reduce variation, and drive improvement in quality and other key KPIs.
* Prepares budgets, schedules, and other financial reports for successful strategy deployment.
* Hires, trains, develops, coaches, and provides team member guidance and supervision in the event of having direct report(s).
* Maintain professional and technical knowledge through benchmarking world-class organizations and personal Continuous Improvement and Business Transformation related training.
* Drives and coaches use of project management principles including establishing and tracking timelines, identifying, and mitigating risks, communicating across teams at all levels.
* Other assigned duties.

**Required**
**The Experience, Skills, and Abilities Needed**

* Bachelor’s Degree (Engineering, Supply Chain and Logistics, or other Technical Field)
* Minimum 15 years of demonstrated qualified Improvement experience in a leadership role.
* One successful enterprise transformation required with experience in deploying lean culture in an organization.
* Minimum 8 years’ experience leading and managing a Continuous Improvement team.
* Demonstrated impact that translates to clear, bottom line performance results with step-function change with ability to produce $3 million in cost savings.
* Strong analytical skills and understanding of problem-solving techniques. Proficiency in analyzing business needs, determining appropriate solutions and/or opportunities, and deploying them.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence, communicate, motivate, instill confidence, and persuade in difficult or complex situations.
* Demonstrated impact using improvement tools: For example, Toyota Productions System and methodologies such as: A3 Development and Management, Process Flow Mapping, 5S/Visual Factory, TPM, QCO-SMED, Standard Work, Process Problem Solving, Built In Quality, Just In Time, Kaizen/Continuous Improvement, Chaku-chaku lines, karikuri devices, DMAIC, Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, statistical data analysis, etc.
* Lean certification from a recognized independent technical organization.
* Experience with improvement leadership in large functional areas i.e., Field Service, R&D, Plant Operations, Administrative Operations, etc.
* Experience delivering training, coaching, and developing all levels: executive to hourly employees.

**Preferred**

* Experience with TPM (Total Productive Maintenance) or the JIPM (Japan Institute of Plant Maintenance, Shingijutsu, or other mentoring by a recognized competent Continuous Improvement consultancy.
* Experience working in Supply Chain disciplines including Logistics and experience with Distribution and Warehousing practices.

**Other**

* Superior and demonstrated leadership, team building, communication, presentation, interpersonal, and coaching skills.
* Excellent organizational skills, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to lead and develop team members

records.title: Director, Operational Excellence & Business Enablement
records.description:
Build Your Career as a Director, Operational Excellence & Business Enablement!
  
  
At BlueLinx, our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to ensuring our team members can build job security, enhance their skills, and make meaningful contributions. We deliver the building blocks to better lives.
  
  
Join us and be part of a company that values its people and strives to make a positive impact on the industry!
  
  
**Why BlueLinx?**
**Comprehensive Benefits Include**

* Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription
* 401(k) with company match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Life Insurance
* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and 8 Company Holidays
* Career Growth: Opportunity to develop and advance your career with a leading building products distributor.

**Job Summary**
The Director, Operational Excellence & Business Enablement leads the development and deployment of the BlueLinx operating system across the branch network. This role converts operational strategy, performance data, and technology investments into standard processes, measurable performance improvement, and sustained branch adoption. Reporting to the Sr. Director, Logistics Systems, the Director partners across Regional Operations, Branch Operations, Commercial, Inventory, Finance, Human Resources, Safety, and Information Technology to improve customer service, labor productivity, cost performance, process consistency, and the adoption of new operating capabilities.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Understands the company’s vision, mission, and strategy; translates business and functional objectives into clear Operational Excellence priorities and measurable outcomes.
* Leads the enterprise operations performance-management process, including metric definitions, monthly reporting, trend analysis, performance reviews, corrective-action follow-up, and continuous improvement of dashboards and reporting methods.
* Owns governance and continuous improvement for On-Time and In-Full delivery performance, including failure-reason categories, functional ownership, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and branch adoption.
* Develops and maintains the BlueLinx branch operating system, including standard work, daily and weekly management routines, branch assessment methods, operating playbooks, and sustainment reviews.
* Leads the operational labor-management strategy, including common productivity measures, labor standards, reporting requirements, and branch improvement plans developed in partnership with Regional Operations and Human Resources.
* Serves as the business process and adoption leader for operations, logistics and warehouse technology-enabled improvement initiatives, including transportation, warehouse management, scanning, labeling, automation, data, and artificial intelligence capabilities.
* Translates operational needs into clear business requirements; leads current-state and future-state process design, operational pilots, field testing, readiness, rollout planning, training, adoption measurement, and post-launch sustainment.
* Maintains the enterprise Operational Excellence project portfolio and prioritizes work based on customer impact, business value, risk, available resources, and alignment with company strategy.
* Partners with Finance to validate expected and realized financial benefits, including direct savings, cost avoidance, productivity improvements, and working-capital opportunities.
* Provides structured problem-solving support for complex, cross-functional, or recurring branch issues while ensuring the accountable function retains ownership of execution and sustainment.
* Builds organizational capability through practical training and coaching in standard work, root-cause analysis, process improvement, visual management, and leader operating routines.
* Identifies proven branch practices and creates repeatable methods to scale those practices across regions and locations.
* Builds strong working relationships with regional, branch, and functional leadership; influences decisions through clear data, practical recommendations, and disciplined follow-through.
* Leads and develops assigned Operational Excellence, analytics, process improvement, or industrial engineering resources and actively supports talent acquisition and succession planning.
* Travel: Up to 50%, based on branch support, project deployment, leader development, and business priorities

**Qualifications**

* Certifications: Lean, Six Sigma Black Belt, or comparable process-improvement certification preferred
* Educational: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field required. Master's degree preferred.
* Generally 5+ years of relevant experience in distribution, manufacturing, logistics, or multi-site operations; demonstrated experience leading people and cross-functional business process improvement

**What We're Looking For**

* Deep knowledge of distribution or multi-site operations, including branch execution, warehouse processes, customer service, labor productivity, and operating cost drivers.
* Demonstrated ability to build performance-management systems that connect measures, root causes, ownership, corrective action, and sustained results.
* Practical experience developing standard work, management routines, branch assessments, and scalable operating playbooks.
* Experience leading cross-functional improvement initiatives from business requirements and process design through pilot, rollout, adoption, and sustainment.
* Strong business analytics capability with the ability to validate data, interpret performance, identify meaningful trends, and communicate findings in plain language.
* Working knowledge of warehouse and transportation technology, business intelligence tools, automation, and technology-enabled process improvement.
* Experience with labor management, industrial engineering, warehouse layout, slotting, material flow, or labor standards preferred.
* Strong facilitation, project leadership, change-management, coaching, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to move comfortably between branch-level observation and executive-level decision support.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, establish decision rights, and prevent temporary project support from becoming permanent functional ownership
* Strong follow-through, sound judgment, and a bias toward simple, repeatable solutions that can be sustained by the field.

Our Values
  
  
With every decision and action, we put people first, keep the future in mind, and work as a team toward shared progress.
  
  

* Customer Centric
* Respect
* Collaboration
* Integrity
* Grit

**About Us**
BlueLinx is one of America’s largest distributors of building products, with over 70k branded and private-label SKUs. Headquartered in Marietta, Georgia, we have over 2,000 associates and distribute our comprehensive range of structural and specialty products to approximately 15k national, regional, and local dealers, as well as specialty distributors, national home centers, industrial, and manufactured housing customers.
  
  
*The salary range provided is a good-faith estimate based on the position requirements and market data. Actual compensation will depend on factors including experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, and other job-related considerations. BlueLinx also offers a comprehensive benefits package including health care, dental, vision, life and disability insurance starting the first day of the month, 15 days of paid time off that start accruing your first day, and 8 paid holidays per year.*
To report any issues with this job posting, please contact talent@bluelinxco.com

records.title: Senior Director of Operations & Transformation
records.description:
**Brief Description**
**About Us**
At
**FreshDirect**
, we are reinventing the grocery experience.
  
  
Since day one, our mission has been simple: bring the best, freshest food directly from the farm to people’s homes — faster, fresher, and smarter than anyone else.
  
  
We’re not just a food company. We’re a technology-powered, customer-obsessed team building one of the most innovative end-to-end food supply chains in the industry. From proprietary routing systems to our state-of-the-art fulfillment center, every part of our business is designed to deliver unmatched quality, convenience, and care.
  
  
We partner directly with farmers, fishermen, and artisans to source the highest quality ingredients — then use smart data, automation, and logistics to deliver them at peak freshness.
  
  
It’s grocery shopping reimagined — and we’re just getting started.
  
  
If you’re passionate about innovation, care deeply about what people eat, and want to help build the future of food, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**The Role**
The Senior Director of Operations & Transformation is responsible for driving operational excellence, strategic initiatives, and enterprise-wide transformation efforts across the organization. This leader will partner with executive stakeholders to improve business performance, optimize processes, and implement scalable solutions that support growth, efficiency, and customer experience.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the role will lead cross-functional projects that enhance organizational effectiveness and drive measurable business impact.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead high-impact transformation and continuous improvement initiatives across the business.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, productivity, and scalability.
* Partner with leaders across Operations, Supply Chain, Transportation, Manufacturing, Technology, and other functions to drive performance improvements.
* Establish and track KPIs, leveraging data and analytics to support decision-making and business outcomes.
* Develop and implement standardized processes, governance, and best practices.
* Lead complex cross-functional projects from strategy through execution.
* Drive change management efforts to ensure successful adoption of new processes and initiatives.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on operational strategy, performance, risks, and opportunities.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years of leadership experience in operations, transformation, continuous improvement, consulting, or a related field.
* Proven success leading large-scale operational and business transformation initiatives.
* Strong people leadership skills with experience building, developing, and motivating high-performing teams.
* Strong project management, change management, and stakeholder leadership skills.
* Experience driving process improvement and operational excellence in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a data-driven approach.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

**Our Values at FreshDirect**
We live these values every day:
  
  
**A Passion for our customers**
Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We listen, innovate, and act quickly to exceed expectations with every order and interaction.
  
  
**One team, one mission**
Everyone contributes & every role matters. We break silos, lift each other up, and share a relentless focus on delivering results. That way, we win together.
  
  
**Delivering excellence, every time**
We take pride in the quality of our food, service, and the experience we create. Our team goes above and beyond to earn trust and guarantee 100% freshness.
  
  
**Act with integrity**
We operate with honesty, respect, and accountability in how we treat our customers, teammates, and partners. We own our outcomes and always do what’s right, even when no one is watching.
  
  
**Make fast, bold decisions**
We challenge the status quo, embrace technology, and take smart risks to build a better future. At the same time, we stay true to our NYC roots and care for our community.
  
  
**We love food. Yes, literally all of us.**
**What You’ll Love About Working Here**

* A fast-paced, innovative environment where ideas turn into action
* Opportunities for growth — many of our leaders have risen through the ranks
* Direct impact on how thousands of customers experience food every day

**Salary**
$170,000-$200,000
  
  
**Total Rewards & Benefits**

* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits
* PTO, Safe & Sick Time, and Paid Holidays
* Medical, Vision, Dental, and Voluntary Disability coverage
* 401(k) with employer match and Life Insurance
* State-of-the-art Bronx campus with on-site basketball court, cafeteria, and employee market
* Onsite FREE parking
* FREE employee shuttle bus service from nearby Subway station
* Training, leadership development, and tuition discount at local colleges
* 20% employee discount on FreshDirect online orders and Brooklyn wine store
* Minimum 50% employee discount at our onsite employee market
* Mobile phone discounts through partnerships with T-Mobile and Verizon
* Gym membership discounts through NYSC

**Our Culture**
We embrace an in-office culture, composed of individuals who thrive on the collaboration and energy that comes from working together in a shared space. We are looking for people who excel in this environment, where physical presence enhances connections and engagement. At FreshDirect, we've created an environment that thrives on teamwork, where associates can innovate, grow, and have successful careers. Many of our leaders have successfully come up through our ranks. Because of our team's extraordinary efforts, we are a leading innovator in the e-commerce and grocery industries.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Fresh Direct, LLC and its affiliates do not discriminate against applicants or employees because of their race, color, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, gender, disability, sexual orientation, age, religion, creed, marital status, veteran status, domestic violence victim status, political affiliation, or any other factor protected by federal, state, or local law.
  
  
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the Team member(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of individuals in this position. Position expectations may be subject to change as the needs of the organization changes.

records.title: Quality Director
records.description:
At Oceans Behavioral Hospital DeRidder, healing is our focus. We are passionate about helping adults and seniors manage the challenges associated with anxiety, depression and other mental health issues. Utilizing proven, innovative and progressive therapies, our qualified professionals strive to promote long-term wellness through a range of inpatient and outpatient psychiatric counseling and treatment options.
 
 
The Director, Quality and Patient Safety plans, develops, implements and manages comprehensive and effective systems to monitor and evaluate the quality and appropriateness of patient services and programs in support of the organizational mission and goals. This position will work closely under the supervision of the Hospital CEO, functions as a support person in the coordination and organization of administrative processes in a high quality efficient and cost-effective manner. All duties to be done in accordance with Joint Commission, Federal and State regulations, Oceans’ Mission, policies and procedures and quality standards.
 
 
**Essential Functions:**

* Works with VP, Quality and Patient Safety implementing organization-wide quality programs at the hospital level.
* Facilitates the hospital Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI) committee.
* Prepares an annual evaluation of the hospital QAPI plan, including process and outcomes.
* Oversees hospital-wide performance improvement (PI) projects identified through on-going data driven quality assessment.
* Coordinates the hospital’s data collection procedures and provides on-going support and education to staff regarding QAPI tools and reporting requirements; utilizes data and collaborates with leadership to set priorities and provide guidance in their development of quality improvement work plans.
* Serves as a resource to the medical staff, administrators and other staff including participation in root cause analyses, as indicated, to investigate potentially avoidable sentinel events.
* Completes assignments accurately, in a timely manner and within procedural guidelines.
* Coordinates education for QAPI principles and regulatory standards as indicated. Conducts training for staff.
* Participates in Joint Commission Accreditation process including plan of action tracking and completion.
* Performs other duties and projects as assigned by the facility administrator and corporate office.

**Requirements**
**Education / Experience:**

* Associate degree or RN diploma required.
* Healthcare experience related to clinical leadership and/or quality assessment and performance improvement.
* Behavioral health experience preferred.

**Qualifications / Skills:**

* Demonstrates proficient computer skills with MS office products and electronic QAPI software solutions.
* Ability to create and provide training programs on related quality performance topics.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision and simultaneously manage multiple projects.
* Knowledge of state and federal regulatory requirements, Joint Commission Accreditation.
* CPHQ certification preferred.
* Must successfully complete CPR certification and an Oceans approved behavioral health de-escalation program.

**Work Environment:**
Subject to many interruptions. Occasional pressure due to multiple calls and inquiries. This position can be high paced and stressful; must be able to cope mentally and physically to atmosphere. Work requires spending approximately 90% or more of the time inside a building that offers protection from weather conditions but not necessarily from temperature changes.

records.title: Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering
records.description:
**Job Summary**
The Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering is a hands-on leadership role and the process authority for how Butcher Power Products’ switchboard and switchgear products are built. The person in this role must be the subject-matter expert who can also do the work — capable of designing and improving manufacturing processes and line layouts, building routings and process documentation, and personally leading process and PFMEA reviews — so they can teach and develop the manufacturing engineering team and set the standard for process quality. This role owns how products are built rather than what is designed; however, deep familiarity with the product and the production floor is essential. The Director must understand the design intent released by Product Engineering and the realities of the floor in order to engineer processes that are efficient, repeatable, and capable. This role works hand in hand with Product Engineering as the manufacturing voice in the design process, partners with Quality on process controls, and supports Production and Planning rather than owning them.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Hands-On Process Engineering: Personally design, document, and improve the manufacturing processes, routings, work instructions, and line layouts that build the product. This is a working role: the successful candidate stays actively engaged in process design and technical problem-solving alongside the team rather than delegating all hands-on work.
* Process Authority & Technical Review: Lead, critique, and approve the team’s process designs, routings, PFMEAs, and control plans; set and enforce the standard for process quality, capability, and engineering rigor through formal process reviews.
* Mentorship & Teaching: Coach, train, and develop manufacturing engineers and technicians in process design, tooling, DFM/DFA, Lean and Six Sigma, time studies, and structured problem-solving, raising the technical capability of the whole team.
* Leadership & Management: Lead and manage the manufacturing engineering team, including hiring, development, workload balancing, priorities, and performance.
* Process Strategy & Standardization: Own manufacturing process strategy and standardization across product lines, and define the tooling and capital equipment roadmap.
* Product Engineering Partnership (DFM): Work closely and continuously with Product Engineering as the manufacturing voice in the design process — provide manufacturability and assembly feedback at design reviews before release, jointly resolve producibility issues, and ensure released designs transition cleanly into production.
* Process Controls & Quality Partnership: Own the manufacturing side of PFMEAs and control plans in partnership with Quality Engineering; ensure processes are capable, controlled, and continuously monitored.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen across the function to improve throughput, cycle time, yield, and cost.
* Capital, Tooling & Automation: Plan and justify capital equipment, tooling, and automation investments, and provide financial management of the manufacturing engineering capital and tooling budgets.
* New Product Introduction (NPI): Lead the process side of NPI — develop and validate the processes, tooling, and routings that bring newly released designs into production.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Production, Planning, Quality, Project Management, and Product Engineering on capacity, scheduling, and material flow, supporting these functions rather than owning them.
* Safety & Compliance: Ensure manufacturing processes across the function comply with safety, environmental, and regulatory standards, including UL 891, NEC, and ANSI.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Industrial, or Mechanical Engineering.
* 8+ years of progressive process engineering (or directly related) experience, including significant time spent personally developing and improving manufacturing processes.
* Hands-on proficiency in SolidWorks for process documentation, line layouts, and reviews; the ability to design tooling and fixtures in CAD is a plus.
* Strong proficiency developing routings, work instructions, process documentation, and process controls.
* Proven ability to lead formal process and PFMEA reviews and to mentor and train engineers and technicians.
* Experience hiring, developing, and managing a manufacturing engineering team.
* Strong working knowledge of PFMEA, control plans, SPC, and process capability (Cpk).
* Deep knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong understanding of the products being built and of how design intent translates into manufacturing process — sufficient product familiarity to engineer the right processes.
* Working knowledge of UL 891 and related standards (NEC, ANSI) as they affect manufacturing processes.
* Experience planning and justifying capital equipment and tooling investments, including financial management of budgets.
* Hands-on fabrication and machining experience is a plus.
* Automation experience is a plus.
* Experience with structured problem-solving methods such as 8D or A3 is a plus.
* Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems, particularly Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).
* Excellent leadership, project management, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on manufacturing process design and improvement (CAD)
* Process authority and engineering quality standards
* Technical mentoring, teaching, and team development
* Close partnership with Product Engineering (DFM)
* Process strategy, standardization, and tooling roadmap
* Design-for-manufacturability partnership
* Process controls, PFMEA, and capability
* Continuous improvement and Lean/Six Sigma
* Capital planning, automation, and financial management
* New product introduction (process side)
* Cross-functional collaboration and communication

records.title: Director of Manufacturing Process Engineer
records.description:
**Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering**

**Location:**
Rancho Cordova, CA (Onsite)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Permanent

**Compensation:**
Up to $225,000 annually

**Start Date:**
ASAP

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on
**Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering**
to lead and develop a manufacturing engineering team within an established electrical equipment manufacturing operation in Rancho Cordova, California.

This is a
**working engineering leadership position**
requiring a strong combination of technical manufacturing expertise, process engineering experience, and team leadership.

The ideal candidate will have direct experience manufacturing
**low- and medium-voltage switchgear, switchboards, electrical power distribution equipment, or related electrical products**
.

This individual will take ownership of manufacturing processes, production efficiency, engineering standards, and continuous improvement initiatives while mentoring and developing a team of manufacturing engineers and technicians.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of manufacturing engineers and technicians.
* Personally develop, implement, and optimize manufacturing processes, production routings, work instructions, and facility layouts.
* Lead Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) reviews, control plans, and process capability improvements.
* Apply Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Collaborate with Product Engineering on Design for Manufacturability and Assembly (DFM/DFA).
* Lead manufacturing process development and implementation for new product introductions (NPI).
* Identify and implement improvements to manufacturing throughput, quality, efficiency, and cost.
* Develop tooling, equipment, and automation strategies to support production requirements.
* Evaluate and justify capital equipment investments and manufacturing improvements.
* Establish and maintain manufacturing engineering standards, procedures, and best practices.
* Partner with Quality, Production, Planning, and Engineering teams to resolve technical challenges.

records.title: R&D NPI Engineering Senior Manager, Project Management

postedPay.title: R&D NPI Engineering Senior Manager, Project Management

records.description:
We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions.

**What You Will Experience In This Position**

The R&D NPI Engineering Senior Manager will be a strategic and hands-on leader who drives on-time delivery and best practices for our new product introduction (NPI) programs within our Data Solutions business. This role will lead, coach and mentor a team of project and program managers to ensure alignment with business goals through effective portfolio and process management. The manager will work closely with business unit leaders, product managers, and engineering leaders to drive and improve on-time delivery and cross-functional collaboration for our portfolio of NPI programs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Development:**
Lead, mentor and inspire a high-performing, global project management team specializing in NPI Program execution. Develop a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and empower the team to drive excellence in project delivery.

**NPI Execution and Delivery:**
Oversee end-to-end execution of projects, ensuring on-time delivery, within scope and on budget while maintaining high quality outcomes.

**Cross-Functional Coordination:**
Partner closely with engineering, product management, integrated supply chain, manufacturing and operations teams to ensure alignment of project priorities, resources, and timelines, facilitating seamless execution of programs.

**Resource Allocation:**
Optimize resource planning and allocation across projects, balancing capacity dynamically to meet changing business priorities and ensure effective utilization

**Portfolio Management:**
Collaborate with key partners to drive the selection and prioritization of NPI projects, connected to our strategic objectives and business goals.

**Continuous Improvement**
: Own and evolve the NPI phase-gate process to ensure consistent and efficient product development lifecycle execution. Drive continuous evaluation and enhancement of our project management processes, tools and methodologies to improve efficiency and scalability of programs.

**Performance & Reporting:**
Define and track KPIs to measure project health and business impact. Lead monthly business reviews to communicate progress, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership.

**You Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering
* Ideally 10+ years of proven experience in NPI or PMO leadership roles, preferably in data or technology-driven environments of which 2+ years of people leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams
* Proven record of leading large-scale, complex projects and driving successful product introductions
* Proficiency in demonstrating expertise in PMO practices, methodologies, tools and processes.
* Outstanding ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and drive results in a matrixed organization.
* Excellent communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem solving and decision-making abilities to drive efficiency and optimize project outcomes.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial, or engineering focused organizations

**We Have**

* A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day
* nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.
* Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nvent.com.
* Commitment to strengthen communities where our employees live and work
* We encourage and support the philanthropic activities of our employees worldwide
* Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money

Core values that shape our culture and drive us to deliver the best for our employees and our customers. We’re known for being:

* Innovative & adaptable
* Dedicated to absolute integrity
* Focused on the customer first
* Respectful and team oriented
* Optimistic and energizing
* Accountable for performance
* Benefits to support the lives of our employees

**Pay Transparency**

nVent’s pay scale is based on the expected range of base pay for this job and the employee’s work location. Employee pay within this range will be based on a combination of factors including knowledge, skills, abilities, experience, education, and performance. Where federal, state, or local minimum wage requirements exist, employee pay will comply.

**Compensation Range**

$123,500.00 - $229,500.00

Depending on the position offered, employee may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as annual incentives.

**Benefit Overview**

At nVent, we value our people and their health and well-being. We provide a broad benefits package with meaningful programs for eligible full-time employees that includes:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans along with flexible spending accounts, short-term and long-term disability benefits, critical illness, accident insurance and life insurance.
* A 401(k) retirement plan and an employee stock purchase plan — both include a company match.
* Other supplemental benefits may include tuition reimbursement, caregiver, personal and parental leave, back-up care services, paid time off including volunteer time, a well-being program, and/or legal & identity theft protection.

At nVent, we connect and protect our customers with inventive electrical solutions. People are our most valuable asset. Inclusion and diversity means that we celebrate and encourage each other’s authenticity because we understand that uniqueness sparks growth.
